candidate.blueprint_locator: Health Promotion and Maintenance — risk reduction and client education
candidate.blueprint_topic: Health Promotion and Maintenance — preoperative optimization
candidate.educational_objective: Identify prehabilitation as proactive preoperative optimization of functional capacity and modifiable risks.

options.A: Begin individualized exercise and nutrition optimization before surgery, with other risk-reduction support such as smoking cessation or psychosocial preparation as indicated
options.B: Wait until a major postoperative functional decline occurs before starting exercise or nutrition interventions
options.C: Avoid activity before surgery so the client can conserve all physical capacity for the postoperative period
options.D: Use prehabilitation only as a substitute for postoperative rehabilitation and routine perioperative care

candidate.rationale: Prehabilitation aims to improve functional reserve before surgery. Programs may include exercise, nutrition optimization, psychological support, education and other modifiable-risk interventions. It complements rather than replaces routine perioperative and postoperative care.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Prehabilitation occurs before surgery and may include exercise, nutrition and other support to improve functional reserve.
candidate.source_document_title: Prehabilitation; 2026 ACS exercise/nutrition prehabilitation evidence summary
candidate.source_locator: ACS Strong for Surgery: improve functional capability before surgery; 2026 ACS review: exercise/nutrition prehabilitation shows recovery benefit
candidate.stem: A client preparing for major elective surgery is referred to a prehabilitation program. Which plan best reflects the purpose of prehabilitation?
